description:
Make the finite-recursive-denotations plan executable by encoding only proven prerequisites.

Replace the stale broad links fz-tfn.62 -> fz-kdt.48 and fz-kdt.48 -> fz-kdt.177 with the already-recorded narrow leaf path fz-tfn.62.2 -> fz-kdt.48.7 -> fz-kdt.48.8 -> fz-kdt.177.4. Add the missing fz-kdt.98.3 -> fz-kdt.177.9 link: the recursive return-group solver consumes CallGraphComponent, which is unsound until cumulative function-reference and resolved value-call edges land.

Update the handoff and proposal diagrams/status prose to match the corrected graph and live stack. Treat fz-qds as a delivery-reliability gate, not a semantic dependency: its documented serial-CI premise is stale while CI runs fixture trials at four threads and repeated json_roundtrip readiness failures remain observable.

Acceptance: fz-kdt.177.5's direct dependency context is unblocked once fz-kdt.177.4 closes, even though bw ready summarizes parent-level work; fz-kdt.177.9 is blocked by fz-kdt.98.3; the documents name the exact dual critical paths and no longer claim whole fz-tfn.62 or fz-kdt.48 completion is required. No production code changes.
title: Correct the recursive-denotation dependency plan
